assessment.confirmed: Any append or activity persistence error permanently latches audit readiness false. No error details were logged by this release. The admission guard invalidated the persistent preview approval and selected pre_gate.
assessment.leadingTrigger: A transient SQLite busy timeout during concurrent management/export traffic; the exact failed operation cannot be proven from existing logs.
assessment.priorOccurrence: docs/evidence/public-beta-rxdb-docs-deployment.json records the same previously undiagnosed audit readiness failure.

behavior: Retry identical immutable audit appends and conditional activity writes up to three attempts only for retryable storage failures.

Record safe stage/error-class diagnostics without event data, identities, credentials, or raw storage errors.
